title: Oh my goodness, these are so soft
text: Oh my goodness, these are so soft. We finally tried out the sheets and were happily surprised by how supple the fabric is, almost a cotton equivalent to velour or thin suede.  They are definitely luxurious and I will be ordering more soon!
